mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.5% within a month signals a tightening monetary policy, which increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate investments, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where FEDFUNDS increased by more than 0.5% within a month.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate by more than 0.2% within a month indicates a strengthening labor market, which boosts consumer confidence and spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances where UNRATE decreased by more than 0.2% within a month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real estate sales (HOUST) by more than 5% over three months signals a strong demand in the housing market, which is a leading indicator of economic growth, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the periods where HOUST increased by more than 5% over three months.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 2% over three months signals a contraction in supply, leading to increased prices and reduced corporate earnings, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where INDPRO decreased by more than 2% over three months.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) exceeds the inflation rate (CPIAUCSL) by more than 1%, it indicates a real interest rate environment that is unfavorable for equity markets, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where FEDFUNDS exceeded CPIAUCSL by more than 1%.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 over a month, combined with a decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.1%, signals a robust labor market, boosting consumer spending and leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases > 200,000 and UNRATE decreases > 0.1% in 1 month
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances where PAYEMS increased by more than 200,000 and UNRATE decreased by more than 0.1% within a month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in retail and food services sales (RSAFS) by more than 5% over three months signals strong consumer demand, which is a leading indicator of economic growth, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the periods where RSAFS increased by more than 5% over three months.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in GDP (GDPC1) by more than 1% over a quarter signals a contraction in economic activity, leading to reduced corporate earnings and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where GDPC1 decreased by more than 1% over a quarter.
